messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023**.  
A long weekend is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a weekday (Monday–Thursday) and therefore gives you a three‑day break (the holiday plus the adjacent weekend days).  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Days Covered | Notes |
|---------|-------------|----------------------|-------|
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, BC, Ontario, etc.) | **Monday, Feb 20** | Fri 18 – Sun 20 | Most provinces observe Family Day on the 3rd Monday of February. |
| **Good Friday** (most provinces) | **Friday, Apr 7** | Fri 7 – Sun 9 | Observed in all provinces except Quebec. |
| **Victoria Day** | **Monday, May 22** | Fri 20 – Sun 22 | Federal holiday; observed nationwide. |
| **Labour Day** | **Monday, Sep 4** | Fri 2 – Sun 4 | Federal holiday; observed nationwide. |
| **Thanksgiving** | **Monday, Oct 9** | Fri 7 – Sun 9 | Federal holiday; observed nationwide. |
| **Christmas Day** | **Monday, Dec 25** | Fri 23 – Sun 25 | Federal holiday; observed nationwide. |

### Quick‑reference JSON (useful for API integration)

```json
[
  {
    "holiday": "Family Day",
    "date": "2023-02-20",
    "weekend_start": "2023-02-18",
    "weekend_end": "2023-02-20",
    "province_observed": ["Alberta","Saskatchewan","British Columbia","Ontario"]
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Good Friday",
    "date": "2023-04-07",
    "weekend_start": "2023-04-07",

  },
  {

    "date": "2023-05-22",
    "weekend_start": "2023-05-20",
    "weekend_end": "2023-05-22",
    "province_observed": ["All"]
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Labour Day",
    "date": "2023-09-04",
    "weekend_start": "2023-09-02",
    "weekend_end": "2023-09-04",
    "province_observed": ["All"]
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Thanksgiving",
    "date": "2023-10-09",
    "weekend_start": "2023-10-07",
    "weekend_end": "2023-10-09",
    "province_observed": ["All"]
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Christmas Day",
    "date": "2023-12-25",
    "weekend_start": "2023-12-23",
    "weekend_end": "2023-12-25",
    "province_observed": ["All"]
  }
]
```

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., “St. Patrick’s Day” in Newfoundland & Labrador or “Family Day” in Manitoba), you’ll need to add those separately.  
> - For a full list of all statutory holidays per province, consider pulling from the Government of Canada’s public holiday API or the provincial government sites.

Happy planning! If you need more granular data (e.g., provincial holidays or exact weekend ranges for each province), just let me know.
